body.name: cross-fitted penalized-minimax Galerkin affine ensemble
body.construction: For each fold \(k\), use only \(\mathcal D_{-k}\) to fit \(\widehat h_{aj}^{(-k)}\), \(j=0,\ldots,J_n^h\), and \(\widehat q_{a\ell}^{(-k)}\), \(\ell=0,\ldots,J_n^q\), and put \(\widehat S_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}=S_a(\widehat h_{aj}^{(-k)},\widehat q_{a\ell}^{(-k)})\) and \(\widehat B^{(-k)}=\sum_{a=0}^1t_a\widehat S_{a,00}^{(-k)}\). For each arm form \(\widehat D^h_{a,j}=t_a(\widehat S_{a,j0}^{(-k)}-\widehat S_{a,00}^{(-k)})\), \(\widehat D^q_{a,\ell}=t_a(\widehat S_{a,0\ell}^{(-k)}-\widehat S_{a,00}^{(-k)})\), and \(\widehat D^{hq}_{a,j\ell}=t_a(\widehat S_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}-\widehat S_{a,j0}^{(-k)}-\widehat S_{a,0\ell}^{(-k)}+\widehat S_{a,00}^{(-k)})\), and concatenate them as \(\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}\). The training Gram and cross-moment are \(\widehat G^{(-k)}=\widehat E_{-k}[\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)\top}]\) and \(\widehat c^{(-k)}=\widehat E_{-k}[\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}\widehat B^{(-k)}]\), and \(\widehat b^{(-k)}=(\widehat G^{(-k)}+\rho_nI)^{-1}\widehat c^{(-k)}\) is unique because \(\rho_n>0\). Partition \(\widehat b^{(-k)}=(\widehat b^h,\widehat b^q,\widehat b^{hq})\) and define scalar weights by \(\widehat\lambda_{a,j\ell}=-\widehat b^{hq}_{a,j\ell}\), \(\widehat\lambda_{a,j0}=-\widehat b^h_{a,j}+\sum_{\ell=1}^{J_n^q}\widehat b^{hq}_{a,j\ell}\), \(\widehat\lambda_{a,0\ell}=-\widehat b^q_{a,\ell}+\sum_{j=1}^{J_n^h}\widehat b^{hq}_{a,j\ell}\), and \(\widehat\lambda_{a,00}=1+\sum_{j=1}^{J_n^h}\widehat b^h_{a,j}+\sum_{\ell=1}^{J_n^q}\widehat b^q_{a,\ell}-\sum_{j=1}^{J_n^h}\sum_{\ell=1}^{J_n^q}\widehat b^{hq}_{a,j\ell}\). Direct collection of coefficients gives \(\sum_{j=0}^{J_n^h}\sum_{\ell=0}^{J_n^q}\widehat\lambda_{a,j\ell}=1\) and \(\sum_a t_a\sum_{j,\ell}\widehat\lambda_{a,j\ell}\widehat S_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}=\widehat B^{(-k)}-\widehat b^{(-k)\top}\widehat D_{J_n}^{(-k)}\). The map from \(\widehat b^{(-k)}\) to the weights is deterministic and Borel. For \(i\in\mathcal I_k\), set \(\widehat\psi_i=\sum_a t_a\sum_{j,\ell}\widehat\lambda_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}\widehat S_{a,j\ell}^{(-k)}(O_i)\), \(\widehat\theta_n=n^{-1}\sum_i\widehat\psi_i\), and \(\widehat V_n=n^{-1}\sum_i(\widehat\psi_i-\widehat\theta_n)^2\). Conditional on \(\mathcal D_{-k}\), all fitted objects use training data only and are independent of the i.i.d. held-out observations; the retained held-out signals are square-integrable under \(\mathrm{ass:heldout-signal-integrability}\).
